name: google
purpose: The person's Google Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides and Gmail
guide:
Google Calendar v3, Drive v3, Docs v1, Sheets v4, Slides v1 and Gmail v1, as the person. A Doc, Sheet or Slides file's id is the long part of its URL (`/d/<ID>/`).

```sh
# Calendar: the next events
curl -s "https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events?timeMin=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)&singleEvents=true&orderBy=startTime&maxResults=10"
# Drive: find files (Docs, Sheets, Slides included)
curl -s 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=name+contains+%27roadmap%27&fields=files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime,webViewLink)'
# Drive: a Doc as text, a Sheet as CSV (first tab), Slides as text
curl -s 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/FILE_ID/export?mimeType=text/plain'
curl -s 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/FILE_ID/export?mimeType=text/csv'
# Docs: the structure (headings, tables); then an edit
curl -s 'https://docs.googleapis.com/v1/documents/DOC_ID'
curl -s -X POST 'https://docs.googleapis.com/v1/documents/DOC_ID:batchUpdate' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"requests":[{"insertText":{"endOfSegmentLocation":{},"text":"\nNotes from today"}}]}'
# Sheets: the tabs, a range, then write or append rows
curl -s 'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/SHEET_ID?fields=sheets.properties'
curl -s 'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/SHEET_ID/values/Sheet1!A1:F50'
curl -s -X POST 'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/SHEET_ID/values/Sheet1!A1:append?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"values":[["2026-10-23","done"]]}'
# Slides: every slide's text
curl -s 'https://slides.googleapis.com/v1/presentations/PRES_ID?fields=slides(objectId,pageElements(shape(text(textElements(textRun(content))))))'
# Gmail: recent messages, then one
curl -s 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages?q=newer_than:2d&maxResults=10'
curl -s 'https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/MSG_ID?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=From'
```

Creating an event, editing a Doc, Sheet or Slides, uploading a file or sending a mail asks the person first unless they allowed changes.
